summary: Build category strategies, sourcing waves, and benefits dashboards with practical procurement exercises. Explore the course and plan team training.
lede: Category management helps procurement professionals turn purchasing data and business demand into category strategies, sourcing plans and measurable benefits. Designed for category managers, sourcing teams, procurement business partners and spend analysts, the training covers spend segmentation, Kraljic portfolio analysis and total cost of ownership. Participants practise validating demand, assessing suppliers and sequencing sourcing waves, then build dashboards to track benefits and report outcomes.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for procurement professionals responsible for turning purchasing data and business demand into category strategies, sourcing plans, and measurable value.
prerequisites: Working knowledge of procurement, purchasing, sourcing, or tender processes is recommended. No programming is required. Bring access to Excel for spreadsheet exercises; prior experience with category management is helpful but not essential.
